content: Temperature (set point) can be set from -50 °C to 50 °C; the factory setting is 2 °C.
A13 is the high alarm limit for the air temperature (factory 8 °C); A14 is the low limit (factory -30 °C).
A03 is the delay before a temperature alarm is raised, 0 to 240 min; the factory setting is 30 min.
A12 holds back the temperature alarm after a defrost, 0 to 240 min; the factory setting is 90 min. A defrost therefore does not raise a temperature alarm on its own.
d01 selects the defrost method: none, electric (EL) or gas. The factory setting is electric.
d03 is the interval between defrost starts, 0 to 48 hours; the factory setting is 8 hours, which gives three defrosts a day.
d04 is the maximum defrost duration, 0 to 180 min; the factory setting is 45 min.
d02 is the defrost stop temperature, 0 to 25 °C, factory 6 °C. d10 chooses what ends a defrost: time (factory), the S5 sensor, or the air sensor.
d06 is the drip-off time and d07 the fan start delay after a defrost, both 0 to 60 min and 0 at the factory.
d18 limits the refrigeration time between two defrosts, 0 to 48 hours; 0 switches it off (factory).
The controller's clock can start a defrost at up to six set times a day (t01 to t06 for hours, t11 to t16 for minutes).
The readout u60 shows the state of the defrost relay, so a running defrost is visible to the network.
